decision: Use torch.cuda.Event(enable_timing=True) in perfkit/timer.py with synchronization only at step/report boundaries, and a zero-overhead no-op context manager when enabled=False.
reason: Avoids per-layer CPU-GPU sync stalls during training while guaranteeing zero overhead when timing is toggled off (required by G6_Instructions.md).

decision: Enforce the 3-part correctness contract in correctness/framework.py: (1) forward & backward grad parity, (2) bit-deterministic rerun equality, and (3) automatic failure when the fast output is multiplied by 1.01.
reason: Directly codifies the Week 1 Gate 1 check ('A broken function fails: lead multiplies one fast output by 1.01, and the test fails').

decision: Standardize baseline repeatability in perfkit/bench.py using warmup steps, locked clocks/seeds where available, and an automated <=5% run-to-run spread assertion across two consecutive baseline runs.
reason: Required by Week 1 Gate 1 check #3 ('Two baseline runs agree within 5% for each part').

decision: Count only non-embedding active parameters (approx 2.68B active of 15B total) + attention FLOPs in the MFU calculation handed off to Team G8.
reason: For sparse MoE (top-6 of 384 routed + 1 shared expert), total-parameter FLOP formulas misreport actual hardware utilization; active FLOPs per token (~6 * N_active + attention FLOPs) gives true MFU.
